#
Like I’ve said, Derek, I actually *live* in PA.
Dr. Oz, on the other hand, does not.
He’s basically like:

John

Dear Friend,

I have some wonderful news to share with you!

body:
Communism, Socialism, and Marxism. These are tough subjects to teach today because most Americans have little to no experience
[View this message in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zaq46lul8cfnmo1rfim2nefsfodi16soukk75vng_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cpjmcor4cjh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpqedtge1p7adjkm4qj7cbkmgor79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onkmep74p7669j61cb16gr7bd34m4r32stjm2q69djksqrmeobgsup74sj1cupneduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6ccdkmmr30sjjcooj9cr4suobapbi4no)
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zib6ticiaobrt3odia58d93u89bmasqequ7g3j30_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cpjmcor4cjh2bs)

Friend,

Communism, Socialism, and Marxism.

These are tough subjects to teach today because most Americans have little to no experience with the horrors they bring.

When most people think of socialism, empty grocery stores, gas shortages, and secret police come to mind.

**Now think of America today.** _Censorship is rampant. Gas prices are spiking. Store shelves are empty of baby formula and other basic goods. Inflation is at a 30-year high_.

Let me introduce myself to you. My name is Zilvinas Silenas, President of the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE).

I grew up in Soviet-controlled Lithuania, and I am terrified of the rise of socialism that I'm seeing in America.

That's why FEE is dedicated to educating the next generation through _FEE in the Classroom_ , where we go to high schools to teach about the ideas of liberty, economics, free markets, and history.

I've set a goal to work with 21,000 high schoolers and provide them an alternative to the woke, socialist ideology that fills today's classrooms.

[_**It costs roughly $22 per child to provide the classroom materials they need. Can I count on you to join the fight and sponsor 1 or more students?

Click here to generously donate $22, $50, $100, or any amount >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zvh21eaunt4lcisnbiq1kvoomov9rjp4ntcb7org_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cpjmcor4cjh2bs)

**With today 's shortages and high prices, it's starting to feel like we're living under a soft communist revolution taking place and destroying our economy.**

It is FEE's mission to inspire, educate, and connect future leaders with the economic, ethical, and legal principles of a free society, including individual liberty, free-market economics, entrepreneurship, private property, high moral character, and limited government.

Socialism is a multi-faceted issue. It's easy to explain the theory, but the day-to-day consequences that millions of people have lived through are hard to understand.

[_**Friend, can I count on you to join the fight and stop the slow tide of socialism that is seeping into America? Click here to sponsor a student >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zs75v90ic4ktbd9p4o0psno47ds40kl70o49viko_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cpjmcor4cjh2bs)

Here is just one example from my childhood:

On May 1, 1986, my family skipped the mandatory workers' parade in Lithuania. Instead of carrying around red carnations, red balloons, and red placards denouncing the U.S. and the West, we went sunbathing at a local lake.

The lake was polluted with industrial runoff from a government-owned leather factory, so swimming was out of the question. Still, the day was unusually warm, so we enjoyed the sunshine, which is not so abundant in the north-eastern climes where Lithuania (then-Soviet Socialist Republic of Lithuania) sits.

What we didn't know was that five days before, on April 26, the Chernobyl nuclear power plant exploded, sending radioactive clouds westwards through Belarus, Lithuania, all the way to Sweden and Norway.

You see, on May 1, we did not know. No one told us. In fact, until the Scandinavians picked up elevated levels of radiation, most people in the Soviet Union did not know what had happened. **That 's how we were treated under socialism.**

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zb6p09rfrgg6lvolhgr21gg947soaei8oe53f090_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cpjmcor4cjh2bs)

During the moment, that was a rare day of sunshine and fun--something that didn't happen often under Soviet reign. But it was still contaminated by the broken ideology that swept over my home country.

Nowadays, the U.S. seems to be under constant propaganda for a radical agenda against individualism, liberty, and free markets. Socialism is gaining ground once again.

* Major leaders in Congress are openly socialist (Bernie Sanders and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez), calling on 70% income taxes and a Green New Deal which would essentially take over our economy.
* Roughly 18% of social scientists in the United States self-identify as Marxists.
* Perhaps most alarmingly, opinion polls show that more young Americans have a positive view of socialism than have a positive view of capitalism.

Young Americans need to know that there is an alternative. You and I need to get in the classroom and teach the ideals of liberty and economic freedom.

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z1dhsatq4cd2vhd567is53j95mn04nqts5albkag_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cpjmcor4cjh2bs)

FEE in the Classroom works, Friend.

We recently sent 75,000 educational books to Nevada, for students to have a source of liberty and free-market economics to learn from.

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zcl3shtesqhoc9jfb1a00lpuomk221aoubb62qko_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cpjmcor4cjh2bs)
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z1qgq756cmhirb6ulg5h02ast0sqm1r7ghaihg7g_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cpjmcor4cjh2bs)
These books represent 75,000 students who now have a chance to escape the socialist dogma they're forced to learn.

The next generation is hungry for freedom and liberty. They want their chance at the American Dream.

Friend, can you pass the torch of liberty on? **Click any amount below to donate.**

| | WASHINGTON, D.C. — Rep. Jack Bergman voted no on Tues. June 14, when the House passed the Recovering America's Wildlife Act (RAWA), which provides $1.4 billion in federal funding for existing State Wildlife Plans. Wildlife conservationists, hunters, anglers, nature lovers, and job creators support the RAWA bill. MI01's current representative, Jack Bergman, does not. "Sadly, this perplexing vote is just another example of how my opponent votes against the interests of our district," said Dr. Bob Lorinser. "I don't know how he calls himself a conservationist when he's directly voting against our way of life." A coalition of sportsmen and sportswomen, conservationists, scientists, states, Tribes, and wildlife advocates support this RAWA. **The bipartisan bill is backed by over 2,000 organizations** , such as the National Wildlife Federation, Ducks Unlimited, Backcountry Hunters and Anglers, the Audubon Society, and the Nature Conservancy. Under RAWA, Michigan could see an estimated $27 million annually to protect vulnerable species like lake sturgeon. **What does this bill do?**
* Address America's Wildlife Crisis that threatens Americans' quality of life and our outdoor recreation economy, which contributes **$887 billion** to our national economy annually, creates **7.6 million direct jobs** , and generates **$124.5 billion** in federal, state, and local tax revenue.
* Wildlife conservation and restoration programs
* Conservation education
* Promote wildlife-associated recreation
* Prevent and control invasive species and disease
* Restore essential habitats and implement key conservation strategies

"These projects create good-paying jobs in the 1st District with substantial economic benefits," said Dr. Lorinser. "Additionally, outdoor recreation activities — hunting, fishing, and wildlife viewing — will be preserved. "Why did he vote against us? Why did he vote against the environment, against good jobs for Michiganders? Don't tell me it was too expensive. Without conservation management, threats to wildlife could damage a $1 trillion contribution to our economy." Dr. Bob Lorinser says MI01's next representative must support hunters and anglers. "Connecting people with nature, promoting conservation education, and preserving outdoor recreation — RAWA is a good, clean, bipartisan bill. Thankfully, it passed, but I'm not sure Jack Bergman truly understands the Northern Michigan / UP way of life."

---
| | | | | | June, 2022 Mid-month Update
---
| VA Delegate John McGuire
I'm running for State Senate so we can un-California Virginia.
Christian Conservative (Father - Navy SEAL - Business Owner)
---
| McGuire, Good, Jordan, and Brat Endorse Yesli Vega for Congress VA 7
---
|
---
| I am happy to see Congressman Bob Good, Congressman Dave Brat, and Congressman Jim Jordan join me in endorsing our friend, Yesli Vega, for the 7th Congressional District. She can beat radical and woke Democrat, Abigail Spanberger, in November. Please ask friends to vote for Yesli Vega in the primary on June 21!
---
| General Assembly
---
|
---
| We have much work ahead of us to make Virginia the best place to live, work, and raise a family. It is an honor to be your voice, represent your interest, and fight for our conservative values in Richmond. Inflation, $5 and rising gas prices, baby formula shortage, high taxes, public safety, CRT in education, school choice, Ukraine, election integrity, infrastructure, rural broadband, healthcare, protecting the sanctity of life, protecting our Second Amendment, and more are on the minds of fellow Virginians. Democrat policies are causing inflation. Interest rates are rising and I believe things are going to continue to get tougher and tougher for fellow Americans. We must get people back to work. Governor Youngkin and the rest of us in the General Assembly are working diligently to address your concerns.
The increased cost of living is probably the #1 concern for fellow Virginians. Everything is more expensive:
gas: +44% airline tickets: +33% used cars: +23% hotels: +23% suits: +22% tires: +16% furniture: +15% milk: +15% coffee +14% deliveries: +14% bread: +14% baby food; +13% soup: +13% cereal: +12% eggs: +1-% dry cleaning: +10%
Farmers are really having a difficult time with increasing fuel prices, increasing fertilizer prices, increasing lime prices and more.
---
| Special Session/ Governor Budget Amendments
---
| Democrats in the Senate dragged things out on the budget and tried to block Governor Youngkin's agenda. But Friday we will vote on the final amendments of the Governor.
There are 38 budget amendments in HB29 and 35 amendments in HB30.
To include:
We will vote on the Hyde Amendment, a legislative provision barring the use of federal funds to pay for abortion.
With $5 and climbing gas prices, we are still pushing for a gas tax holiday, even though democrats are highly opposed.
I will vote to fully fund the Education Improvement Scholarships Tax Credit (EISTC) program. It is Virginia's only school choice program.
The Governor's message:

Governor Glenn Youngkin Announces Budget Amendments RICHMOND, VA - On Wednesday, Governor Youngkin sent thirty-eight budget amendments, three in HB 29 (the caboose budget) and thirty-five in HB 30 (the biennial budget), focusing on expanding opportunities for education, keeping our communities safe, and making Virginia the best state for business. The General Assembly will consider Governor Youngkin's amendments when they reconvene on Friday.
"With five-dollar gas prices and plenty of money in the system, I'm continuing the effort to lower gas prices for hardworking Virginians and my hope is, this time, that Democrats will join us to give Virginians a break this summer," said Governor Glenn Youngkin. "We're also restoring educational freedom by protecting the education scholarship tax credits which expand parental choice. clean_body: reengage this crucial voting bloc! | Derek, In non-presidential years, fewer people turn out to vote. Last year was no different. While we saw record turnout numbers for a Virginia Gubernatorial election, turnout still paled in comparison to 2020, especially among younger Virginians. We need to engage young voters across the Commonwealth to replicate the successes we had in previous years.= The youth vote (18-40) had a 41.6% drop in turnout between 2020 and 2021. If we want to avoid a repeat of last year’s results, we need to meet voters where they are, explain why the Democratic Party is the party that represents them, and reenergize those young voters who stayed home last year. body:
Derek, this just changed everything: Adam Laxalt (R) is officially the GOP nominee for Senate here in Nevada, where he and I will face off this November in the race that will determine control of the Senate.
Keeping this seat and the Senate blue will come down to your grassroots support. So I’m urgently asking you: Will you split $27 or more right now between my campaign and CommonGood so we can keep Nevada and the Senate blue? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20220616_CGVA_CCM]
Your support right now could not be more important: The Cook Political Report, National Journal, and Roll Call have all named me the most vulnerable senator in America — and Nate Silver himself at FiveThirtyEight says this is the GOP’s best pickup opportunity.
Polling already shows me 3 points down, that’s why Mitch McConnell and his super PAC are about to unleash $18 MILLION on vicious attack ads to defeat me.
The first few days of the general election are crucial. But McConnell’s attacks will completely overwhelm us and drown out my voice in this vital moment – unless I can raise the resources to fight back. That’s why I set an ambitious general election fundraising goal, but with time running out before the midnight deadline, I’m falling dangerously short.
Please, Derek, I’m personally counting on you: Will you become a general election founding donor and help us hit this goal so we can defeat Adam Laxalt, win in Nevada, and defend our Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20220616_CGVA_CCM]

**I was thrilled when the Chicago Teachers Union (CTU) voted to endorse my campaign for IL-01.**

I am a longtime supporter of the hardworking and dedicated teachers, paraprofessionals, and clinicians who work tirelessly with and for our children in Chicago’s public schools.

Demanding the best for our children must be our top priority, including:

✅ Expanding universal pre-K to give young children a real head start
✅ Providing relief for college student loan debt
✅ Making community college free for low-income students
✅ Creating hands-on apprenticeships for high school seniors and community college students

Friend,

As we continue to learn more about the January 6 attack, who was involved, and why it was allowed to happen, one recent headline that caught my eye was how Rep. Barry Loudermilk was giving tours of the Capitol on the day before the insurrection. While there is a lot we don’t know, this revelation shows that more questions need to be answered, and that the American people need more information about the attack. It also doesn’t inspire confidence that Rep. Loudermilk was caught claiming that the tours, which were caught on tape, never happened.
But our team at RAP made sure to call out his lies. Dear Peter,
New endorsement alert! So excited to have received the endorsement of Corey Davenport, a managing partner with Estabrook Partners. If I’m blessed to be Maryland’s next Governor, I’ll be a champion for our local small business community. I’ll dramatically improve the operating environment for small business owners and entrepreneurs in our state by cutting the red tape and improving access to state contracts, capital, and credit.
I’ll also promote economic inclusion for our minority and women-owned businesses (MWBEs) by increasing the state’s MWBE goals by 50%, to bring our goals more in line with the state’s demographics.
You can learn more about why Corey is endorsing our campaign by watching our new video below:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/coreydavenportendorsement?amount=20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/coreydavenportendorsement?amount=20.22]
I’ve received more endorsements than any other candidate in this race, and our coalition of support only continues to grow stronger in these final weeks before election day.
We have the momentum in this race – and with your help, we can pull ahead even further in this critical period for our campaign. Will you help make this moment count by chipping in to power our movement to victory? We’re looking to gain 52 new grassroots donations by 11:59 PM tonight, and your support can help get us there.
CHIP IN $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/coreydavenportendorsement?amount=10]

CHIP IN $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/coreydavenportendorsement?amount=100]
CHIP IN ANOTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/coreydavenportendorsement]
We have an exciting opportunity to change the way that government does business in the years to come. My bold vision for Maryland includes combating the student debt crisis, protecting and expanding access to abortion care, leveling the playing field for Black Marylanders, and so much more. Together, we can deliver the concrete results and bold solutions that will lift our communities into the higher quality of life that they deserve.
Our challenges are sweeping – so too must be our solutions. Enough talk, let’s get it done! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/coreydavenportendorsement?amount=20.22]
Thank you,

name: John Lira
subject: Why this deadline is important
body:
We have a big deadline coming up and we need to be ready. | Peter, I wanted to reach out to you personally today to talk about a big deadline we have coming up in two days and why it’s so important. But first I want to share what we’re up against. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46600797/350953753/-321368219?refcode=em20220616_image&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNTY5MGM5ZS05M2VkLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=91wIjkxxuurcZ3NURyq_yTxoO11pXR5raLQBZ_R7SqY=) That’s right, the representative whose district just suffered the worst mass shooting in a decade has voted no Protecting Our Kids. No Violence Against Women Reauthorization. No Enhanced Background Checks. No Bipartisan Background Checks. **Now it’s time for Texans to return the favor and vote no to Tony Gonzales this November.** I’m ready to take his seat and be the voice and the fighter for the people — not the gun lobbyists and corporations. But to get there, I’m going to need your help. [**I spoke with the team and in order to stay on track for our fundraising this month, we need your help to raise $10,000 by midnight on Saturday. name: Great America Update
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6157%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=zBwyJA4x5otWFO6MhR1hwA&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63599%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=sFB7YFVKrR9WtY5hB7cKng&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63590%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bME%2b13BY%2byGPIzb%2bEfMpew&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63590%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bME%2b13BY%2byGPIzb%2bEfMpew&sysid=1)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

name: Mitchell Carey
subject: Protect LGBTQ+ rights & urge your senators to pass the Equality Act!
body:
| | Hi Friend, **Nice to meet you! My name is Mitchell Carey (he/him), I’m 22, and I’m a text team volunteer with NextGen America.** I first became involved in politics in 2016 when I realized that many politicians don’t represent young Americans and don’t invest in our hopes for the future.

**As a member of the LGBTQ+ community, it was horrifying to see our political leaders promote discrimination over equality throughout this country.** I knew I needed to get involved. When the 2020 elections started, I discovered NextGen on social media and recognized this was the perfect opportunity to take action.

**The lives of people in the LGBTQ+ community are inherently political.** We don’t have the luxury to stay on the sidelines because our lives are too often on the line. We are constantly fighting legislation that inhibits our ability to live freely and safely as ourselves.

**But we have a voice, and I urge you to use yours.** Contact your legislators, volunteer, vote, and do what you can to show up for this community.

I believe that young people are the most interconnected generation in United States history, and I know that in order for real change to happen, we must elect leaders who represent us, our values, and our communities. **Most of all, I believe that if young people want change to happen, we must take charge of our futures and get involved in whatever way we can. ** **So for this Pride month, I’m asking you to join me in taking action.** [**Will you send a letter to your senators to urge them to pass the Equality Act?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46601882/350956776/171258708?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYWM4YmFiZC05NWVkLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ATn9beCETw8Liino6yoBsIOZsEqUPhS5vffqI-RbNCA=&emci=10a78948-d6ec-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=eac8babd-95ed-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172) The dangerous far-right majority on the Supreme Court coupled with bigoted Republicans in state legislatures poses a real threat to the safety and rights of the LGBTQ+ community. The Equality Act would provide comprehensive protections on the basis of sexual orientation and gender identity nationwide, essentially carving out LGBTQ+ protections into existing civil rights law. [**Send a message: Tell your senators to pass federal protections for all LGBTQ+ people in housing, health care, education, and public accommodations by passing the Equality Act.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46601884/350956778/-1394825233?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYWM4YmFiZC05NWVkLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ATn9beCETw8Liino6yoBsIOZsEqUPhS5vffqI-RbNCA=&emci=10a78948-d6ec-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=eac8babd-95ed-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172) | [Take action](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46601886/350956780/1098787287?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYWM4YmFiZC05NWVkLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ATn9beCETw8Liino6yoBsIOZsEqUPhS5vffqI-RbNCA=&emci=10a78948-d6ec-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=eac8babd-95ed-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172 "CTA Button")

clean_body: | | | | [Trouble viewing this email? Try it in the browser.]() | | | | | | Peter - Virginia’s 6th Congressional District has been dominated by the same political machine since 1993. In that time, our district has had just two Congressmen. The second and current Congressman, Ben Cline, was Chief of Staff to the previous Congressman. Rep. Cline has never faced a primary challenger. He was installed as his boss’s successor in a convention and without the input of voters. Ironically, Rep. Cline talks about wanting to drain the swamp. Well, I’m here to help him do that. I’m Merritt Hale and I’m running to bring new leadership to our 6th District. I’d like to tell you why I’m running for office and how my views and values differ from those of Rep. Cline. Ben Cline Refused to debate me, so I published an article outlining how I can revitalize the district. | If you’re going to hide behind the establishment and refuse to debate your opponent or interact with your constituents, it is clear that you’re not working for the people you represent. You are in it for yourself. That’s not the type of leader our sixth District needs. My background as a Navy veteran, a systems engineer, and a Washington outsider will bring a unique perspective to Congress and our country’s overall health. I ask for your vote on June 21, and encourage all registered voters in the 6th District to please vote because that’s the only way to effect change and put new leaders in office. Otherwise, we will be back with the status quo and the 14 percent approval ratings of a do-nothing Congress. | We thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to the coming days. Sincerely, Merritt Hale Merritt Hale for Congress PO Box 302,, Clear Brook, VA 22624 == \- == |

Hi team,

Today, you may have heard that the NDRC has announced our initial 2022 Democracy Targets ahead of this fall’s elections. I’m following up to explain why investing in these targets is so important to our work ahead.

[_Before I continue, will you please rush a donation to help the NDRC invest in all of our efforts to end gerrymandering?_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46602285/350957835/792749532?amount=20&refcode=20220616.2r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM0YTMyYWUxLTk1ZWQtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=NZ2E1-hd97kstHy8uDg9YgDbbzzOOMP_BqOCHEJm5S8=)

When we launched the NDRC in 2017, we knew that securing fair maps would be a multi-year fight and that it wouldn’t take one redistricting cycle alone. But **we didn’t know how far the GOP would go** to cling to their manipulated maps and undermine our democracy more broadly.

So the NDRC has had to expand both our timeline and our scope of work. Redistricting no longer ends once the last state has adopted its maps; Republicans have admitted that they see it as a battle that continues year after year. And to defend democracy from right-wing attacks on fair maps, the freedom to vote, elections and election workers, and even the truth (including the truth about who won the 2020 presidential election), **we now have to fight on more fronts than we ever imagined back in 2017**.

That’s why I’m grateful to [_you, team, for being there when we’ve asked and donating when you can._](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46602286/350957836/792749532?amount=20&refcode=20220616.2r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM0YTMyYWUxLTk1ZWQtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=NZ2E1-hd97kstHy8uDg9YgDbbzzOOMP_BqOCHEJm5S8=)

The 2022 elections will be critical to keeping our fight going and protecting our hard-earned victories. The NDRC is planning to target races in at least **17 states** where we can help protect fair elections, hold Republicans accountable for their cheating, and support democracy-upholding Democrats. Our goal is to invest in gubernatorial races, state legislative races, state supreme court races, and other important statewide and relevant local races all over the country.

But here’s the deal: **How much we’ll be able to do in the fight for fair maps depends on the support of this community.**

That’s why I’m asking for your help today. We’ve achieved so much together, but the threat to our system of government, and our fundamental values, is more real than ever. We simply can’t give up, and we can’t stop fighting. Not now, not ever.

[_If you’re able, I hope you’ll chip in with a contribution today._](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46602287/350957837/792749532?amount=20&refcode=20220616.2r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM0YTMyYWUxLTk1ZWQtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=NZ2E1-hd97kstHy8uDg9YgDbbzzOOMP_BqOCHEJm5S8=) | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

| | Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family.

body:

[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z2u0tovcaue081f4hhfbj7gmm73fublrm3ha8jag_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37c9l6cqj7djl6eqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbpj2cdmmar7cobhcphn9c5lmqor2d36elgjap30cqr68pb66aom8spkc8o6eodnmv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj666qbbcj7mpg6cc9imdgmfc5lclp238h1e8he4933clim2o30cdj64oh5u)

---
| |
Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story—especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---
| | **This is why we’ve produced our online course, “The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King,” which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy using this secure link:**

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z7d5ri6jlnihtt8fi5f1fni9021s5tm249tqi8i0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c5g60or6c9h2bs)** By viewing the course, you’ll learn more about the nature of God, family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you’ll learn more about what truly matters in life. **I hope you’ll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or homeschool curriculum.**
---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zaglmrif5jgurpmpctc1je7cq8m8i3vm0e5afum8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c5g60or6c9h2bs)
---
| | Let’s learn what truly matters in life by studying **“The David Story.”**

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

**P.S.** If you’d like to secure a DVD box set of **“The David Story”** while they’re available, you can have one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more in support of reaching and teaching millions on behalf of liberty.

Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. Now, I'm asking for your help to make it to the top of the Hill this time around | [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=7e49fbe0d8464d938e7459b62ba28cd0&_e=mBmOMkhpgk7RJGHlfUXYja2RiuyfJSO1u8btvp9xmhN3dBgmUnb8-y8peV4hz3zPljg5yQjrl-AjjcINVRuoZqBb0GgWvXiykHuravRKdhhSnbhixHUiWtNgbPx1MrBpHdC7_hQIwcSc5sm9jnvBislMNIIdMJqZj7iwoJr9aWWfx2O4R1DRkjCNmAZFHMJdOFMew4F6MNNwtOYUdYs1YZA98RKo9iO7UtTKQ_5c8mI2mjTeidNMEmGu7iNgNolCHBbwrgS3ztOn5NnlT34AXUl1M3OxuS8lRMQ9RTIy9P6DGFEvDX9-plY_Xj6gDRnYpe2BS-N4UhGNDWvtDEmvcNqCUWdA1xgD1qXxccL8Ajtj5TGdtF6uXaCMVUYpi8GTLtXfpjzm9FJAw5NWy6dRw0WmvXEMDJXKUVq88IhqeA0hKwsW4fGt5MDrWF2OSGpuYNlv512UFNsXj7rKiFDBT-e3VbO1An1j3iv3Eb1qkQAZaXW5OEnmaELfr16Htgg3)

Fellow patriot,

Not too long ago, Hispanics were _expected_ and _assumed_ to be Democrats by anyone with a passive interest in political demography. In fact, **until recently, Hispanics were about as Democrat as suburbanites were Republican.**

I’m helping to change that narrative. I’m not a **“coconut”** - - brown on the outside, white on the inside - as some have called me. And I’m certainly not a **“self-hating Hispanic,”** as others have labeled me. My name is Monica De La Cruz, **a proud Hispanic Republican,** and I’m running for Congress in Texas’ 15th Congressional District to flip a seat RED which has never been held by a Republican in its HISTORY.

Last year, I ran for the same seat in Congress I’m running for today. New Mexico does post-election canvasses and audits to make sure the results are accurate. There are pathways for relief and to get questions answered, but flouting our Constitution and nullifying the votes of a whole county _are not it._

| It's actually worse than that. The entire Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP - food stamps) is bound by the Biden admin's interpretation of Title IX (now to "include discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity"). This means that any place that accepts food stamps but doesn't have gender neutral bathrooms could, in theory, be subject to investigation if someone brings "allegations of discrimination based on gender identity or sexual orientation."

So let me unpack this for you: your kids' public schools are, in effect, required to allow a confused boy to enter your daughter's bathroom. Or put another way: the Democrats want to force-feed your kids with their gender and sexual orientation ideologies. They're leaving you with no escape. It's worse than this, though, because they are targeting the poor and middle-classes. If they truly cared about the poor and middle-class, why would they do this?

Well, it's because they don't care about you. They don't want the votes of poor white people...they think of you as deplorable. They assume black people will vote for them, and exploit race ideologies to offset the fact that they literally couldn't care less about black people's livelihoods. This is their down-payment to develop a generation of uncritical, radical sheep that will blindly vote for them based on a personal identity that the Democrats have exploited.

This is what we're up against. And this is why they're after your kids.

How do we stop it?

subject: Looking Toward Father's Day
body:
| | | |

# Fatherhood
---
|
---
|
---
| Of all the things I have done and accomplished in my life, everything seems dim compared to being father. When I hold my children in my arms, the world's woes diminish, and life feels brighter, more hopeful.
With Father's Day right around the corner, I have been reflecting on the importance of fatherhood and how becoming a dad radically changed me. My life is no longer my own and my days are often consumed with making decisions that account for my family. My three amazing children are the reason I am running for Congress.
God's greatest gift to humanity is life, and we experience it most unadulterated, most innocently through our children. Megan's and my greatest joy, peace, and love are our kids, and we feel very blessed to be their parents. And I am willing to do whatever it takes to assure the America they grow up in is one they are proud of, where they have the opportunity to achieve anything, and where they feel safe and secure.
My run for Congress is not for me, it is for my children and future generations. I am willing to relinquish my peace, to risk much of what I hold dear, in order to fight for freedom, virtue, and goodness so that our kids have a brighter future. I desire to help turn America back towards a path grounded in principle where wisdom prevails and harmony between fellow human beings is the norm rather than the exception. Together, as Americans, I know we can build that Shining City on a Hill if we come together joined in the cause of Truth, championing the sanctity of Life, and always seeking to do what is right.
May this Father's Day weekend be filled with love and appreciation for the gifts God has granted us and may all of us continue to fight for a brighter, more beautiful hope-filled future for our children.
Happy Father's Day.

## About Erik

| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

clean_body: | | | | | | Fatherhood | | | Of all the things I have done and accomplished in my life, everything seems dim compared to being father. When I hold my children in my arms, the world's woes diminish, and life feels brighter, more hopeful. With Father's Day right around the corner, I have been reflecting on the importance of fatherhood and how becoming a dad radically changed me. My life is no longer my own and my days are often consumed with making decisions that account for my family. My three amazing children are the reason I am running for Congress. God's greatest gift to humanity is life, and we experience it most unadulterated, most innocently through our children. Megan's and my greatest joy, peace, and love are our kids, and we feel very blessed to be their parents. And I am willing to do whatever it takes to assure the America they grow up in is one they are proud of, where they have the opportunity to achieve anything, and where they feel safe and secure. My run for Congress is not for me, it is for my children and future generations. I am willing to relinquish my peace, to risk much of what I hold dear, in order to fight for freedom, virtue, and goodness so that our kids have a brighter future. I desire to help turn America back towards a path grounded in principle where wisdom prevails and harmony between fellow human beings is the norm rather than the exception. Together, as Americans, I know we can build that Shining City on a Hill if we come together joined in the cause of Truth, championing the sanctity of Life, and always seeking to do what is right. May this Father's Day weekend be filled with love and appreciation for the gifts God has granted us and may all of us continue to fight for a brighter, more beautiful hope-filled future for our children. Happy Father's Day. | | | | | | | | == | | | About Erik | | | Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Peter, Asian Americans have been at the mercy of the radical Left’s identity politics for too long.

When we’re attacked in the street, we get social media infographics saying “stop Asian hate!” and false promises.

_But when our children want to get into college, we’re told to “check our privilege”._

_According to the Liberals, if we’re not Democrats, we’re “not real minorities.”_

**And when our families want to legally immigrate to America to work hard and live the American Dream, we’re told to “get in line” behind illegal criminals at our Southern border.**

**Enough is enough.**

We deserve representation that _actually_ stands up for our families, not Leftist identity politics.

**I’m not a “white guy in an Asian suit.” I’m a legal immigrant. A proud Vietnamese-American. And an unapologetic conservative.**

name: Adam Schiff
subject: The 2005 federal law protecting the gun industry from legal liability
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR CONGRESS
body:
| Every industry in this country is subject to some form of legal liability except for one — the gun industry.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=379%2E5257348%2EF6LNsy)
Derek,
Every industry in this country is subject to some form of legal liability except for one — **the gun industry**. And it’s time that survivors of gun violence and the families of victims get their day in court, when gun industry negligence has contributed to the tragedy.
The gun industry’s legal liability shield, passed in a 2005 federal law at the NRA’s behest, silences the voices of gun violence victims — even when gun makers and sellers act negligently.
_The NRA called the bill their #1 legislative priority at the time. And no wonder._
Look, I don’t think that people should be able to buy assault weapons, period, and I favor banning them. And if the makers and sellers of these weapons are marketing them to kids, or negligent in how they sell them, and the purchasers go on to commit the kind of attacks we saw two 18-year-olds unleash in Buffalo and Uvalde last month, I don’t want the gun industry getting a pass. They should be held to the same standard of care as every other industry. But until we remove the gun industry’s legal liability shield, the survivors and families of victims can’t do a thing in court.
However, there is one way we can change that:
I’ve taken the fight to the gun lobby by introducing the _Equal Access to Justice for Victims of Gun Violence Act_ so that victims and their families would have the right to hold gun manufacturers and sellers accountable just like every other American industry — and force them to make their productssafer and use best practices when they sell them. **President Biden has called this legislation his very top priority when it comes to gun safety.**
_“Most people don’t realize: The only industry in America, billion-dollar industry, that can’t be sued, exempt from being sued, are gun manufacturers...If I get one thing on my list, Lord came down and said, ‘Joe, you get one of these,’ give me that one.”_ — President Joe Biden
When you peel back the layers, there is a reason that stopping my bill is also the top priority for gun makers and dealers:
For the gun industry and the Republican senators whose campaigns they sponsor, it’s about money. Dollars and cents. Profits. The bottom line. That’s it. That’s all. Not the safety of our communities or their products. Not kids’ lives. Nothing else matters.
So I’m asking for your help to change that, so victims and their families can sue the gun industry for the carnage they are unleashing on innocent folks across our country when they act negligently — the only country that experiences this epidemic of gun violence.
[**Add your name as a citizen co-sponsor of my _Equal Access to Justice for Victims of Gun Violence Act_ today and together, let’s finally hold the gun industry accountable to the victims and families when they act negligently towards the public safety.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20220616-gun-liability.xknGwH&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220616_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=379%2E5257348%2EF6LNsy)
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20220616-gun-liability.xknGwH&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220616_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=379%2E5257348%2EF6LNsy)
---
Thanks for raising your voice on such an important issue.
— Adam

The race for New York’s new 10th Congressional District will be a crowded field, but we have one advantage most candidates do not:
Bill de Blasio has represented these communities for most of his adult life. There’s mutual respect and appreciation there. There’s love there.

name: Nan Whaley
subject: “Ohio enacts absurd law arming teachers in the classroom”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Whaley/Stephens
body:
We do know what Ohioans want: An overwhelming number want commonsense measures that will make our communities safe, such as universal background checks.

**“Ohio enacts absurd law arming teachers in the classroom”**
_-Vanity Fair, 6/14/22_
Team,

Once again, Mike DeWine has folded to the gun lobby, this week by signing a law that puts guns into our schools.
_Vanity Fair_ is right –**this law is absurd, and it makes our schools and our communities less safe. **
The kicker: The law requires just 24 hours of training to bring deadly weapons into the classroom – before, more than 700 hours were needed.
**[I’m running for governor because I believe we need action to end gun violence, not absurd laws that cater to the gun lobby. Please, chip in to my campaign right now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46611107/350998323/-145084247?refcode=nw_email_220616_1_t2_a&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZjEwNjJkZS1iNWVkLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zOPE_c3eMZ3HzkYHKYe2UJYTkkme245pIyG3OTRD_tg=)**
Three years ago, in the wake of a deadly shooting in Dayton, we called on Mike DeWine to take action on gun violence.
Putting guns in schools isn’t the action Ohioans want, and he knows that: When asked if he thought this was what we had in mind, he simply responded, “I don’t know.”
**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46611108/350998324/-145084247?refcode=nw_email_220616_1_t2_a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZjEwNjJkZS1iNWVkLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zOPE_c3eMZ3HzkYHKYe2UJYTkkme245pIyG3OTRD_tg=)**

Dear
Fellow American,

World War
II is the greatest armed conflict in human history, encompassing
global fighting in unprecedented ways.

But
today, only around one percent of the 16 million brave Americans
who fought in the war are still alive.

As we
lose more and more of these courageous soldiers, we also lose the
living memories they carry. But we must preserve the lessons
learned from this world war.

That's
why Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The
Second World Wars." And right now, you can receive your very own
DVD box set of this course when you make a tax-deductible gift of
$100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on
behalf of liberty.

This
limited-edition DVD set provides an analysis from military
historian Victor Davis Hanson of Allied and Axis investments and
strategies in the air, by water, and on land that led to the
Allies' victory.

This is
one of the most popular Hillsdale courses of all time. And there
are only a limited number of DVDs available. If you'd like to
secure a DVD set before they're all gone, you can have one
shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to
Hillsdale College.

Simply
use this secure link to reserve your copy of "The Second World
Wars" on DVD today:

https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars

Thank you
for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans
through education with Hillsdale College!

Best
regards,

Kyle

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

The Democratic establishment was reeling after AOC defeated the 4th most
powerful Democrat in the House. The Democratic Congressional Campaign
Committee (DCCC) was scrambling so much to stop progressives that it
created a Blacklist.

What was the DCCC blacklist? It started in early 2019 and it blacklisted
any vendors, staffers, and organizations that supported primary
challengers to Democratic incumbents — officially putting the interests of
a handful of corporate-backed, conservative Democrats above the will of
Democratic voters.

Why did the DCCC do it? House leadership was afraid more Justice Democrats
like AOC and Ayanna Pressley would defeat long-time incumbents. They were
afraid of the Squad growing. They were afraid of a stronger challenge to
the corporate-backed establishment in Congress.

The DCCC was trying to block working-class progressives from a slew of
critical campaign resources. But Justice Democrats were ready to meet this
anti-democratic policy.

Two of our recruits, Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman, still defeated long-time
corporate incumbents in 2020 while the DCCC Blacklist was in effect. We
were not afraid of the Democratic establishment and we continue to win
races despite the odds stacked against us.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110586?refcode=em20220616-23873&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=23873%2E1203867%2EIfIcoo ]In order to continue winning races against the deep-pocketed
corporate-backed Democratic establishment, we need the help of our
grassroots supporters. Peter,
can you chip in $3 to help
us run strong campaigns and elect more Justice Democrats?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110586?refcode=em20220616-23873&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=23873%2E1203867%2EIfIcoo ]Contribute

The DCCC announced an end to the blacklist after the 2020 elections — it
was more of a PR nightmare for them than an effective tool against
progressive primaries.

But we’re not surprised that House Speaker Nancy Pelosi continues to
support corporate Democrats like Henry Cuellar and Danny Davis against our
primary challengers instead of using her time and resources to protect her
Democratic majority. It’s too important for corporate Democrats to protect
their corporate donors — and that means fighting progressives.

Justice Democrats started because we can’t just elect Democrats, we have
to elect BETTER Democrats — progressive leaders like AOC, Ayanna, Cori,
Jamaal and others who fight for Medicare for All and a Green New Deal.

Pelosi chose Cuellar in TX-28 against Justice Democrat Jessica Cisneros.
Cuellar voted against abortion rights, labor rights, AND worked to block
Build Back Better, all in the last two years. Those are huge parts of the
Democratic agenda. But Pelosi still backed Cuellar.

While we fight for economic, social, racial, and environmental justice,
corporate Democrats like Pelosi, Cuellar and Davis will try to protect
corporate profits and the status quo.

We don’t take a cent from corporate PACs. Meanwhile, corporate Democrats
take money from Wall Street, Big Oil, Big Pharma, payday loan companies,
and union-busters. It’s clear: Justice Democrats will fight for the
people, the Democratic establishment will work for their corporate donors.

candidates? Together, we can overcome the odds and grow the Squad in
Congress.

body:
I’m here to tell you about my friend John.
#
Hi Derek,
My name is Gabby Giffords. I'm a former congresswoman, and 11 years ago, my life was changed forever when I survived a mass shooting at a constituent event in my hometown.
I decided to turn my pain into purpose by becoming a national gun safety advocate, and I've never looked back.
**But today, I'm not writing to talk about myself. I'm here to tell you about my friend, John Fetterman.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220616-1?refcode=em20220616-6222&refcode2=6222_434096_BnOHW_&akid=6222%2E434096%2EBnOHW_)
Over the years, I’ve watched him fight for his community of Braddock and working families in Pennsylvania. Last month, Pennsylvania voters turned out in record numbers to vote for John in the Democratic primary, helping him win all 67 PA Counties.
**We need John’s leadership and moral voice in Washington. But with CNN calling Pennsylvania the #1 Most Likely to Flip Senate Seat, he can't win this fight without grassroots support.**
**That's why I'm personally asking, Derek:[Will you contribute $5 or more now to help John Fetterman win in Pennsylvania, keep the Senate blue, and build a country that works for all of us?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220616-1?refcode=em20220616-6222&refcode2=6222_434096_BnOHW_&akid=6222%2E434096%2EBnOHW_) **
I can’t emphasize this enough: With the Senate split 50-50, Democrats are holding on to our majority by a single thread. Donald Trump, Dr. Oz, and all of their GOP allies are flooding PA with millions to defeat John and retake Senate control.
Everything we care about — from health care to gun safety — is on the line in this race. John’s campaign is 100% people-powered, so he's relying on your support today to help him fight back, pull ahead, and win.
**I told John I'd help him raise $25,000 before his fundraising deadline at midnight tonight, so I'm counting on you to give whatever you can:**
**[Derek, will you chip in $5 — or even $10 — right now so John Fetterman can win in PA and defend our Senate majority?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220616-1?refcode=em20220616-6222&refcode2=6222_434096_BnOHW_&akid=6222%2E434096%2EBnOHW_) **

All my best,
Gabby Giffords

It’s time for action.
#
I’m proud to share with you, Peter, that this morning, the Judiciary Committee – which I chair – voted to advance the nomination of Steve Dettelbach to the Senate floor.
This is an important development for a number of reasons.
Since 2015, the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives (ATF) has been without a Senate-confirmed director thanks to gun lobbyists who want the position to remain empty. That must change.
And now, while we move to take legislative action to combat the scourge of gun violence plaguing our country, we need a strong, capable leader at ATF who is ready to enforce the laws already on the books.
**[Peter, this is a crucial step in the fight to end gun violence. Will you join me by adding your name to urge the full Senate to confirm Mr. Dettelbach?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46612918/351005814/-2001171292?ms=dd_em_220616_1&refcode=dd_em_220616_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Englewood&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMWY4YjkxZC1iZGVkLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_51yOzJjkHmZIxtYeDjBAVwXCpF22NrvM1ZLPKhy_KU=&emci=f86f2214-aced-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=e1f8b91d-bded-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2727974)**

name: Derek Kilmer
subject: Wouldn't be here without you, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by People for Derek Kilmer
body:
What we've accomplished recently.
Peter,

As we inch closer and closer to the finish line this November, I wanted to take a moment to share with you some of what we've accomplished recently.

Last week, I was proud to co-sponsor and help pass gun safety reforms through the House as part of a bipartisan effort to protect our kids and communities from gun violence. I was also honored to join my colleagues in the New Democrat Coalition to officially announce our action plan to fight inflation and cut costs for families across the country.

I'm committed to standing with Washington families to lower inflation, pass important gun safety legislation, solidify the right to choose, and push back against extremist politicians who continue to put far-right values over the American people.

Peter, for too long, Mitch McConnell and other Senate Republicans have fought tooth and nail to block meaningful reforms from becoming law. I am proud of this team and everything we've been able to accomplish despite these challenges, but it's clear that there is more important work that lays ahead -- including defending the slim Democratic House majority so we can keep fighting for progress on behalf of all Americans.

The change we've made so far comes as a direct result of this grassroots team's commitment. Now, we are over the halfway mark to the election, and I am calling on you once more to ensure that my campaign is equipped with all of the tools needed to win this race. That's why I'm humbly asking:

**[Will you consider donating $10, $5, or whatever you can before midnight tonight to help us reach our mid-month goal? Every dollar makes a difference. As always, it's an honor to represent you,

Derek Kilmer

body:
#
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46613043/351006308/1260720466?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&refcode=AU_MLJ_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220616_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83ODAzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NzYzYTY4ZS1iZGVkLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5OdcK2g4BUb8HzmNdXehDvBs4KEL-laxzU8cAL_kc04=)

Folks, the racist media attacks on Mondaire just keep on coming.
**Nearly 80% of members of Congress have voted by proxy over the last year.** You never hear about it.
But this week, the right-wing rag known as the _New York Post_ published a story criticizing Mondaire for voting by proxy for a few days last summer.
What’s the difference this time? Why all the faux Republican outrage? And why a front-page story when other members of Congress have voted by proxy far more frequently?
**_Mondaire is Black and openly gay—and he’s been calling out the GOP on their BS._**
To make matters worse, they even slapped a photo on their front page claiming it was Mondaire – when it clearly wasn’t him.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46613044/351006309/1513024438?refcode=AU_MLJ_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220616_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83ODAzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NzYzYTY4ZS1iZGVkLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5OdcK2g4BUb8HzmNdXehDvBs4KEL-laxzU8cAL_kc04=)
Mondaire has always been one of the most heavily targeted Democrats in Congress. Tucker Carlson did a segment on him just a couple of weeks ago when Mondaire stood up to Republicans and the gun lobby, and the threats have been pouring in.
On the eve of Juneteenth, we're seeing racism rear its ugly head yet again.
Representatives on both sides of the aisle have used the House’s proxy voting policy to work remotely. In fact, House GOP conference chair Elise Stefanik used the proxy vote while appearing with Trump at a Mar-a-Lago fundraiser just earlier this year.
Either way, we know this outrageous story won’t be the last misleading attack on Mondaire. Fellow American,

Tom Cotton here, reaching out to you today about my friend and fellow conservative veteran, **Tyler Kistner**.

Tyler served on active duty for nine years, including four overseas tours. He stepped up to run for Congress in 2020 because he saw the radical agenda Democrats have for America. Bo Hines opposes gay marriage .
In February, the House passed the Equality Act.
This is incredibly important legislation, especially given the rise in hate crimes and violence that the LGBTQ community has faced nationwide. So I thought I’d ask you your opinion:
Do you support the Equality Act?
YES [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2206-q2-wn-equality?refcode=220616-email-yes]
NO [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2206-q2-wn-equality?refcode=220616-email-no]

I have worked to further these goals by authoring the “Equality for All Act” in the State Senate and cosponsoring the Hate Crimes Prevention Act . I also authored the bill to fully repeal HB2 (The NC bathroom bill.)
In Congress, I will continue to support legislation that moves us toward a more equal society, and always stand up for the rights of the LGBTQ community.
We must stand up for our LGBTQ neighbors at all times, and even more so now as they face increased discrimination and hateful legislation in Republican states.
Thank you for your time,
Wiley

If we fall short at this pivotal moment, it’ll be a signal to Soros and his RINO lackey McConnell that their smear campaign targeting my kids is actually paying off. But it’s grassroots, America First patriots like YOU that’ve made me the FRONTRUNNER for the 1 SEAT needed to flip the 50-50 Senate... ... | "I think there is a time for change, and this is that time.
I am certain that Ally could be doing so many things with her life right now, but I'm so grateful she's been willing to stand up and stand for principles that allow people to feel heard and restores some trust.
She's willing to listen, but she's also willing to sit down at the table and come up with ideas that really protect our rights and our understanding as a conservative party.
Ally brings a hope that if you have principle-based leadership, and you're willing to take time to listen to one another, then we can make good decisions.
I believe it is time to have a fresh perspective. Someone that comes from a perspective of a mother, as a wife. And it's time now for some healing and true leadership that goes back to those principles that protect and actually enable families and communities to flourish and govern themselves. And I know Ally really believes in those principles."

BY THE EDITORIAL BOARD
CHICAGO TRIBUNE
The Republican primary for the 6th District features six candidates. Burr Ridge Mayor Gary Grasso says, in the wake of the mass
shooting at an elementary school in Uvalde, Texas, he’s open to a frank discussion on gun control. He doesn’t think teens should
have access to assault-style rifles, and suggests use of such weapons could be confined to gun clubs. “Background checks should
also be part of the discussion,” he told us. “I am willing to do what we have to do to keep our children safe.”

[http://email.mail.electoraladvantage.com/c/eJxtjrtuwzAMRb_GGg09LMkeNARF0yHpY-nQLgX1tAo5diw1afr1lTsXIEAClzw85iNadf_jxvdv9iUPmt0e-F15XR9Rms2WPT9d347dejmwkPz55bbsyw5ZRSi3xKOoKKYUCyLIgHvctZ5rjS3BHMveYiabDk8QU-uSM2VeIYG9wKlAcK2ZJzQqpkFIIfgA2pCOeTl4wSWxFWcMxx4lNZay5IbtGrqvlTdMPQ_zHJKDJeaNVIMph3yya53-c94WnI1Qu6CgpQbHBOlwTyT1ULW9bT8XF9Cq7HKNKcUsNvvwp18__AL_EF8b] Burr Ridge Mayor Gary Grasso
talks before a 6th Congressional District forum in Countryside on May 4, 2022. (Antonio Perez / Chicago Tribune)

Conversely, one of his opponents, Orland Park Mayor Keith Pekau, toes the NRA line. Speaking about Salvador Ramos, the 18-year-old
shooter in Uvalde, Pekau told us, “If in fact there was no history, if he was completely law-abiding, what’s going to solve that
particular problem — someone that just snapped?” We think there’s a lot more that can be done, starting with much more sensible
gun control. Also in the race is Orland Park lawyer Scott Kaspar, who wants to ban mail-in voting and early voting, Glen Ellyn
energy consultant Niki Conforti, and Robert Cruz and Catherine O’Shea, both of Oak Lawn. Grasso is endorsed.

Jun 13, 2022 at 5:00 am

clean_body: Chicago Tribune Editorial: Grasso is endorsed. [] BY THE EDITORIAL BOARD CHICAGO TRIBUNE The Republican primary for the 6th District features six candidates. Burr Ridge Mayor Gary Grasso says, in the wake of the mass shooting at an elementary school in Uvalde, Texas, he’s open to a frank discussion on gun control. He doesn’t think teens should have access to assault-style rifles, and suggests use of such weapons could be confined to gun clubs. “Background checks should also be part of the discussion,” he told us. “I am willing to do what we have to do to keep our children safe.” [] Burr Ridge Mayor Gary Grasso talks before a 6th Congressional District forum in Countryside on May 4, 2022. (Antonio Perez / Chicago Tribune) Conversely, one of his opponents, Orland Park Mayor Keith Pekau, toes the NRA line. Speaking about Salvador Ramos, the 18-year-old shooter in Uvalde, Pekau told us, “If in fact there was no history, if he was completely law-abiding, what’s going to solve that particular problem — someone that just snapped?” We think there’s a lot more that can be done, starting with much more sensible gun control. Also in the race is Orland Park lawyer Scott Kaspar, who wants to ban mail-in voting and early voting, Glen Ellyn energy consultant Niki Conforti, and Robert Cruz and Catherine O’Shea, both of Oak Lawn. Grasso is endorsed. Jun 13, 2022 at 5:00 am To see the story on the Chicago Tribune website click here [] Request a yard sign! Hello,
Today, the January 6th Committee held another public hearing.
One big question that still remains unanswered: **What exactly was Chuck Grassley’s plan for January 6th?**
On January 5th, Chuck Grassley told reporters that he – not Mike Pence – would preside over the certification of the Electoral College votes. Grassley said of Pence: “We don’t expect him to be there."
It’s time to come clean, Senator. What was the plan for January 6th? Why did you not expect VP Pence to be there? Were you aware of – or even part of – the plot to overturn the 2020 election? What would you have done had Pence not shown up?
I served our country for over 36 years in the U.S. Navy. I repeatedly swore an oath to protect our nation from all threats, foreign and domestic. I am now running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because I will not stand idly by while Donald Trump and his Republican lap dogs attack and whittle away at our democracy.
I’m now the Democratic nominee against Chuck Grassley here in Iowa, and the GOP attacks against me have already begun.
**In order to fight back against all of Grassley and McConnell’s Super PAC attack ads, we need to raise another $65,000 before midnight tomorrow – but right now we are still falling short. body: Background on revelation that FBI lied to the Congress on its investigation of Trump [NEWSLINK] BREAKING NEWS... [600x300] [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59147&L=27481&F=T&] FBI Chief Comey Misled Congress’s 'Gang of 8' Over Russiagate, Lisa Page Memo Reveals [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59147&L=27481&F=T&] Source: Real Clear Investigations [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59147&L=27481&F=T&] The FBI deceived the House, Senate and the Justice Department about the evidence undergirding its investigation of President Trump, according to a recently declassified document and other material. A seven-page memo dated March 8, 2017, shows that "talking points" prepared by Lisa Page for then-FBI Director James Comey for his meeting with the congressional leadership were riddled with half-truths, outright falsehoods, and critical omissions. Tellingly, Lisa Page also personally briefed Mueller about the FBI's investigation when the special counsel took over the case in May 2017. | Friend,

The Utah Republican party primary election on June 28th is closed, meaning **only registered Republicans are eligible to vote**. So where does that leave 562,727 Utahns who are registered as “unaffiliated,” or new and unregistered voters?

Fortunately, there is still time to participate in the Republican primary election. **New and unaffiliated voters can affiliate online at vote.utah.gov** until June 17th and **in person at county clerk offices or polling locations through Election Day**. To register or affiliate in person, please bring at least two forms of identification to your polling location.

If you haven't received a ballot by mail go to vote.utah.gov to check your voter status and ensure you are registered to participate in the primary election.

**Share this message and donate today** to help us let unaffiliated voters know they still have an opportunity to vote.

It feels like every day now, we get blasted with new revelations about how Ginni Thomas — the wife of Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas — tried to overturn the 2020 election. And let’s not forget: earlier this year, Justice Thomas failed to recuse himself from a case on this very subject. He was the only justice to vote against requiring that Trump White House records be turned over to the January 6 House Select Committee. Records that might have included texts from his wife. **Today would be a good day for Justice Thomas to announce that he’ll recuse himself from any more cases about the insurrection. Or we could bypass the honor system, pass my judicial ethics plan, and overhaul the broken recusal process.** [_**If you’re outraged about this blatant conflict of interest, will you add your name to say that Justice Thomas must recuse himself on this issue going forward — and that we need to strengthen judicial ethics?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46617202/351022921/-980357457?refcode=EMZX_SCO_E_20220617_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNzQ2OWM5Mi1jZmVkLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uqA18gVrc5_1uoduQic55tW_t55hsgnd-40X5BJxQDQ=&emci=05469c92-cfed-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=07469c92-cfed-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908) In case you haven’t been following the latest gory details about Ginni Thomas, here’s a quick run-down:
* After the American people elected Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, Ginni Thomas was texting Donald Trump’s chief of staff with false theories about the election results and trying to give him pointers on how to pull off a coup.
* She pressured 29 Arizona state lawmakers to overturn the state’s election results, defy the will of the voters, and hand their electoral votes to Trump.
* And we JUST found out that she was emailing back and forth with one of Trump’s lawyers, John Eastman — who cooked up an unconstitutional scheme to try to get Mike Pence to single-handedly declare Trump the winner on January 6.

All this, and Justice Thomas still didn’t see fit to recuse himself — let alone disclose his connection to the issue at hand, or offer an explanation to the public for his decision. **My Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act would toughen up recusal rules, institute a basic code of ethics for the Supreme Court (can you believe that doesn’t exist already?), and strengthen judicial ethics across the board.** [_**Add your name if you agree: Justice Thomas is a walking, talking example of how the federal judiciary needs stronger ethics rules, and he can’t keep ruling on cases about the coup attempt his wife participated in.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46617203/351022922/-980357457?refcode=EMZX_SCO_E_20220617_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNzQ2OWM5Mi1jZmVkLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uqA18gVrc5_1uoduQic55tW_t55hsgnd-40X5BJxQDQ=&emci=05469c92-cfed-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=07469c92-cfed-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46617204/351022923/1189167046?refcode=EMZX_SCO_E_20220617_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNzQ2OWM5Mi1jZmVkLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uqA18gVrc5_1uoduQic55tW_t55hsgnd-40X5BJxQDQ=)

Peter,

As I’ve crisscrossed the country this year supporting Republican candidates, meeting supporters, and speaking to patriots, there’s one question I keep getting asked: _**“Will you run for office again?”**_

I’ll tell you this right now – **I’m not done.**

The primary is in less than two weeks! We must win the primary before we can advance to the general election. Tim has been attacked on all sides because they know he is the only one who can beat Brittany Pettersen in the general election. That couldn’t be further from the truth. I’ve been telling you that this day would come for some time now - and now that day has finally arrived. I have seen the dangers of this world, and I have stood up for freedom in the face of terrorism. I know the strength it takes to stand up and fight for what is right - which is why I want to take on the anti-American, radical-Left in Washington. My life’s mission has always been to represent the America I know and love - the world’s bastion of freedom and economic prosperity. Thank you, Alek Skarlatos Republican for Congress SUPPORT A CONSERVATIVE REPUBLICAN FOR CONGRESS | Alek is a former Oregon National Guardsman, completing a nine-month deployment in Afghanistan. Alek, along with four others, stopped an armed terrorist on a Paris-bound train traveling from Amsterdam to Paris in August 2015. Friend,

Usually I send you updates on our fundraising progress, but today I’m sharing something a little different. I know, what’s more important than fundraising, right?

Our answer: Your input! Last week we sent you a Democracy Survey [https://secure.ngpvan.com/n4aBmhPbBUCE0EmKSs4j4Q2] so you could share what’s going on in your community. Many of you took the time to tell us your thoughts and I want to share a few of the responses that captured the moment really well:

Penelope says the Jan 6th hearings are beginning to restore her confidence that the country’s moving forward on the right path.

While Richard wants to know: “What are the consequences of this fall’s key races? I’m worried about how this will affect 2024.”

Chris knows the Big Lie is important to call out, but wants to make sure we aren’t stuck in the past.

And Carlos wants to make sure “we don’t put the fox in charge of the hen house” (If you ask Jocelyn, she’d say “don’t put the arsonist in charge of the fire department.”

Emily said “We can fight back, but we need to make sure every voter in Michigan knows the truth.” (OK, fine, that one was me) [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=061622]

OK, I’m sorry, but I had to on that last one. When we hear this kind of feedback, we know we need to keep pushing hard to make sure that all Michiganders know Jocelyn's historic impact on democracy and election security and, most importantly, hear what she'll do in her next term as our Secretary of State.

That’s when I can go back to our team and say, “We need to ramp up the efforts and we have the budget to do it! Let’s go!”
We’re reading all of your responses, so keep ‘em coming!

https://secure.ngpvan.com/n4aBmhPbBUCE0EmKSs4j4Q2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/n4aBmhPbBUCE0EmKSs4j4Q2]
And if you want to chip in today, you can support Jocelyn right here. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=061622]

Thank you,
Emily Mellits

But we want to hear from you.

We want to know how you’re feeling about things now and in the near future. Your opinion matters to us and we welcome your thoughts.
https://secure.ngpvan.com/n4aBmhPbBUCE0EmKSs4j4Q2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/n4aBmhPbBUCE0EmKSs4j4Q2]

How confident are you about the future of our democracy?

Thanks for sharing your thoughts, friend, and for being part of this campaign.

-Team Benson

| Friends,

I hope you’re staying safe and cool as this heat wave rolls through Texas.

As we endure record setting temperatures, Texas is also setting record-high energy usage.

**It’s only June.** We shouldn’t be _this_ hot and we shouldn’t be relying _this_ much on air conditioning.

**This is not normal.**

Texas needs a representative who believes in science and takes active steps to combat climate change so you don’t have to suffer through dangerous heat waves.

[**Will you donate $15, $25, or $50 to elect a representative who believes in climate change and will put your safety first?**](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=0e2b325bf1&e=4712f71bea)
