We can’t afford to sit back any longer.

**We need to take action now.**

That starts with electing a representative who will make Texas’ 13th District a leader in clean energy and work tirelessly to create a healthy future for you and your family.

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: 10 years of DACA
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Republicans will not stop trying to rollback immigrant rights and opportunities in this country.
#
Peter,
As a proud immigrant who arrived in America alone when I was 16, I know the importance of programs like the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA).
DACA has allowed 800,000 Dreamers to study and work in the U.S. without fear of deportation. I will always believe: Dreamers are American. Dreamers are home. Dreamers are us. That’s why it was such an incredible moment for justice, equality, and our Dreamers when President Obama implemented DACA in 2012.
But it hasn’t been smooth sailing for DACA. Trump attacked it. A court ruled in favor of a Republican-led lawsuit last year blocking new DACA applicants from getting approved. While the case is appealed, DACA’s future remains uncertain. It’s cruel, it’s unjust, and we must fight back.
[**Add your name to our petition showing our full support for DACA. Our voices matter as this case moves through the courts.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/support-daca-2022/?source=em20220616-1353&t=1&akid=1353%2E420207%2EzFSxX4)
**[Add your name](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/support-daca-2022/?source=em20220616-1353&t=2&akid=1353%2E420207%2EzFSxX4)**
Under Trump, we witnessed unimaginable cruelty and heartbreak: children separated from their families, immigrants locked up in for-profit prison detention centers without adequate nutrition and public health, a Muslim ban, turning away asylum seekers and refugees, a complete demonization of immigrants from every part of the GOP.
Republicans will not stop trying to rollback immigrant rights and opportunities in this country. It’s our job to fight back, advocate, organize, and protect hard-won gains like DACA. For all of us who believe in the humane and moral treatment of immigrants, we must continue our work forward.
[**Please sign on to our petition supporting DACA and expressing our full support for immigrant rights and justice in America.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/support-daca-2022/?source=em20220616-1353&t=3&akid=1353%2E420207%2EzFSxX4)
**[Add your name](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/support-daca-2022/?source=em20220616-1353&t=4&akid=1353%2E420207%2EzFSxX4)**
In solidarity,
Pramila

I’ll tell you this right now – **I’m not done.**

name: Jeremy Parkin
subject: Volunteer opportunity for you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Join Team AOC for a deep canvass training this Saturday.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220616-3113-header&t=1&akid=3113%2E2526796%2EnSKSsy)
With just under five months until Alexandria’s reelection, we need as many volunteers as possible to talk to voters in our district about Alexandria and her accomplishments in Congress.
Through phone banking, we can have real, quality conversations with voters. Our approach emphasizes personal stories, empathy, and asking questions in order to find common ground. These tactics are tried and true and will help us make sure we re-elect Alexandria to Congress this fall!
But to reach every voter — including those in new neighborhoods added to our district by redistricting — we're counting on people like you to volunteer their time.
**We’re hosting phone banks every Saturday starting next week on June 25 and we want you there.[Please sign up for a phone bank here and help us reach every voter in NY-14 to make sure they’re ready to re-elect Alexandria this November!](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14709?source=em20220616-3113&utm_source=em20220616-3113&t=2&akid=3113%2E2526796%2EnSKSsy)**
Here are the event details:
---
[Remote Phone Banking for AOC](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14709?source=em20220616-3113&utm_source=em20220616-3113&t=3&akid=3113%2E2526796%2EnSKSsy)
Saturdays starting June 25
1 - 3pm ET
Zoom
**[Get more info or RSVP](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14709?source=em20220616-3113&utm_source=em20220616-3113&t=4&akid=3113%2E2526796%2EnSKSsy)** _We always include a training before each phone bank, so if it’s your first time, no worries!_
These direct, one-to-one conversations are proven to make a huge difference when it comes to voter turnout and changing minds — and the more volunteers who sign up, the more meaningful conversations we can have.
Thank you so much for all your support, and we hope to see you next Saturday and beyond.
In solidarity,
Jeremy Parkin
Field Director
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ocasio-campaign?refcode=em20220616-3113-P_ORG_VOL_GRM&t=5&refcode2=3113_2526796_nSKSsy&akid=3113%2E2526796%2EnSKSsy)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20220616-3113-P_ORG_VOL_GRM&t=6&akid=3113%2E2526796%2EnSKSsy)**

body:
Gun violence has taken our friends, family, and loved ones. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953yOQozAy4249GfohatM8XLCP7Gyf6bzrkjN8sXh_JjXvDm21fvmGLhqUe-quR3_x0a4ZLzkfrFqdtVKuNIuwQsn0c91jgEdSA5OANsq926BffC7faAQGaBY74u73WFJVk63Qd1NBWU74kbcnup6v9nPH6EkX8d7iW_RU51Vehnd5p6BmR3GEKHjVbfAirWS7d9Trw-HNtc51Oc8lKX6dV_HTD4BZkle_Gu6KaxxjUXkXizRlTD8PJxJI6RqcVrWOKORzaNAF09xvoDzx7A5FKnt-4b70ubk6sMD3my63-5WtIBEYD3ySNBxxyYs7JvKyu70CGueX0ff0jCOgIxnhrd36KMa1CcuoEuZaFUo--XvPQ/3my/yi4cxC3lTzmjPlczFkAYsg/h0/znLchEYcNnlqWeYWccI4s5P_U06vWBJW7vBb5_Rh-so) Dear Friends, For so many of us here in Chicago, gun violence has taken our friends, family, and loved ones. body:
Dear Friend,

Join us for our next Participate PA event with partners in the fight against gun violence for a book talk and Q&A with former gun industry executive and current Giffords Senior Advisor,

Ryan Busse. The focus of the event on Thursday is on his book "Gunfight: My Battle Against the Industry that Radicalized America."

The event is a continuation of topics we explored at the Keystone Progress Summit - Pennsylvania’s Progressive Summit, and is also hosted by Gun Owners for Safety, Center That CARES, Keystone Progress Education Fund, and Squirrel Hill Stands Against Gun Violence.

WHEN: Thursday, June 23 at 6:30 - 8 p.m.
WHERE: Coughlin's Law Kitchen and Ale House, 10 Virginia Ave, Pittsburgh, PA 15211

RSVP TODAY [https://www.kpef.info/kpef-events/gunfight]

Ryan Busse is a former firearms executive who helped build one of the world’s most iconic gun companies. “Gunfight" is an insider’s call-out of a wild, secretive, and critically important industry. It shows us how America's gun industry shifted from prioritizing safety and ethics to one that is addicted to fear, conspiracy, intolerance, and secrecy. It offers a valuable perspective as the nation struggles to choose between armed violence or healing.

Don't miss out on this opportunity to come together with faith leaders, gun violence prevention advocates, and concerned citizens to build a safer Pennsylvania.

[https://www.kpef.info/kpef-events/gunfight]

We highly encourage all attendees to have at least two doses plus a booster of an FDA approved COVID-19 vaccine. Masks are optional and will be available upon request.

See you there!

Laura Nevitt
Operations Manager

Fellow patriot,

As I’ve crisscrossed the country this year supporting Republican candidates, meeting supporters, and speaking to patriots, there’s one question I keep getting asked: _**“Will you run for office again?”**_

I’ll tell you this right now – **I’m not done.**

I ran for Governor of California last year because I couldn’t stand to watch what Gavin Newsom and the Democrats are doing to my state, and I knew I could do something about it. **And I care too much about my country to sit and watch Biden and the Democrats destroy it too.**

That’s why I launched Elder for America PAC this year. But this is just the beginning, and when we get to the next phase [**I need to know I will already have you on board.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=fd6783b76c0849d59ec87b1727acf7cf&_e=LoZhXLzuvAmRjYn6S9Jk3Yr8tuNXWLf5V5KhTbTCh4Qka8T76cIvWeUP2u0gNUMdBF6Y554j68PpGjEMpAVN1Uo0vxZCV6EJ-N-DL4v4uiM7_vFv3o47tOdTEu1N2TesEkcjC8L7HZX1Cc4OL9L4GyOthBDPph9POxXNtxi1QVaHwbb_rf4s_0SIoGg8eiNPvcm3YYPikvhrMluFkLgl1JUBueL2g84C7P27TXBe0pi7M_a5Hx5E4sxhY8tfovjOGNGCdUJc0-wxalF7KJprl_72-P8W_IEWTxjx7uJW1cPqPBZvrAFbO_nUa3tija_IE4_H3N37FSq4p17EOhrQjVmzY4L4kuj_QGEoBcm37GiCS2zTpTxa84m7-hJry42lkuGESYKfhx-ee-vUIixZ3YfvUMBi6vXb6_ffMM6CRX20lv1fUMeEaRWjwDBRn0X8)

# Early voting underway!

Early voting began Monday for the June 28th GOP Primary in Cook and DuPage Counties. Here's your opportunity to choose the candidate that will make the 6th Congressional District a Republican one.

We have a genuine opportunity to send a message throughout Illinois and Washington, DC that Americans are fed up with the Biden Democrat agenda. We have a real chance to win back Congress for Republicans and send Nancy Pelosi packing!

I'm asking for your vote in the 6th Congressional District Primary.

I'm an engineer, lawyer, father and husband who is worried the American Dream is fading away. [I've had the opportunity to experience that dream](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=6b94a4f2f9&e=9931950ab1). [My father came to this country from the then Communist country of Latvia just after WWII](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=eaddb40d85&e=9931950ab1). He settled here in the Chicago area and married my mother a fourth generation native of Chicago from Beverly here in the district. Together, they taught me and my siblings about the values that make for success in this country. And we as a family are concerned our American success could be at risk.

[We've set up a webpage](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=9b62ecc04d&e=9931950ab1) you can use to get the information you need to help you vote now during the Early Voting period and on Election Day.

I'm ready to serve on day one in Washington. It is my pledge to you follow the Constitution when I go to Washington--not the politicians. I supported President Trump from the beginning because he believes in the greatness of America. And I'll support that agenda as well if you give me the honor of representing you.

I thank you in advance for your support at the June 28, 2022 primary election.
